author: Author
comingSoonDesc: Event planning and RSVPs are in progress.
deleteEventBody: The event and its attendee list will be deleted permanently.

subscribe.hint: Add this address as a calendar subscription (Google Calendar: "From URL", Apple Calendar: "New Calendar Subscription"). New and changed events show up there on their own. The link is personal; do not share it.
subscribe.renewHint: Shared or lost the link? A new link stops the old one; add the new one to your calendar again.
subscribe.renewed: New link made. The old one no longer works.
subscribe.title: Subscribe to club events

title: Events
requestedMsg: The organisers will confirm your sign-up for «{{title}}».
waitlistedMsg: «{{title}}» is full. You move up as soon as a place is free.
requiresApproval: Confirm sign-ups (organisers decide on each one)
linkedOne: You are looking at the event from your notification.

attendance.legend: ✓ present · E excused · · absent or not recorded · empty: not expected
attendance.noEventsHint: Give trainings a group, then its members count here.
attendance.nobody: Nobody expected: give the event a group or sign members up.
attendance.title: Attendance

groupHint: Its members are expected when attendance is taken (for example a training's team).

repeat.skipHint: Tap a date that is cancelled (holidays).

series.deleteBody: This date belongs to a series. Deleted dates and their sign-ups are gone for good.

descriptionPlaceholder: What can people expect? What should they bring?
isPublicHint: May also be shown outside the club, e.g. on an open Discord server. Otherwise only members see it.
maybeHint: Maybe: no place held, the organisers see it
maybeSetMsg: You might come to “{{title}}”. No place is held for you.
maybeRemovedMsg: You no longer have an answer for “{{title}}”.

public.title: Public events
public.hint: Events marked “Public event” can be seen by anyone without signing in: as a calendar to subscribe to and as a list for your website. Attendees, groups and notes stay in the club. {{count}} upcoming right now.

trialSpotsHint: People who aren't members yet can book this training on the club's trial page. Empty: no trial places.
trialSpotsInvalid: A number from 1 to 100, or empty

trials.title: Trial trainings
trials.subtitle: People who aren't members yet book a training on the trial page. You set trial places on the event.
trials.pageHint: Link it from the club's website. A booking counts once the person confirmed their email address.
trials.emptyNoEvents: Give a training trial places (edit the event), and it shows on the trial page.
trials.deleteBody: The booking of {{name}} and their details are deleted.
trials.retention: Bookings are deleted half a year after the training, unconfirmed ones after a week.

federationSharedHint: Your member clubs see the event under Events › From your association.

cancel.title: Cancel {{title}}
cancel.subtitle: The event stays in the calendar, marked as cancelled. Everyone signed up and the event's group hear it with the reason (bell, push, mail, messengers).
cancel.doneMsg: Everyone signed up has been told.
cancel.reinstatedMsg: Everyone signed up has been told.

templates.saveSubtitle: Place, time, places, settings and description are saved, the date is not.
templates.name: Template name

cancellationDeadlineHint: After this, members can no longer cancel themselves.
endDateBeforeStart: The end date is before the date
timeToBeforeFrom: The end is before the start
noMine: You haven't signed up for any event.
emptyHint: Plan the next event; members can sign up for it right here.
emptyMember: Once an event is planned, you can sign up for it here.

notes.trainedHint: Shown on the next date of the series.
notes.trainerNoteHint: Only those who take attendance see it.

channels.hint: The event is always in the calendar. Each channel also follows its own settings.
channels.none: No notification: only in the calendar.
